<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from the OpenAPI document (`data_avalanche_api::openapi`). Don't edit: change the source and run it again. -->

Every node serves the API on `globals.api.address`. `globals.api.auth` decides which credentials a node takes: none, basic (one user, admin), or a bearer JWT whose roles are mapped (config §6.3). The [`openapi.json`](/data-avalanche/openapi.json) this page is rendered from is `GET /v1/openapi.json` on a node.

**Roles.** A route's *least role* is the lowest that may call it: `viewer` reads, `operator` also runs the pipeline commands, snapshots and config reloads, `admin` also makes a node leave the cluster or shut down. With `auth: none` every caller is `admin`; with `auth: basic` the one user is `admin`; with `jwt` or `oauth2` the token's roles are mapped by `roles_claim` and `role_mapping`.

**Answers.** Every body is a JSON object; a refusal carries an `error` string. Every route can also answer `503` (the node is starting or stopping, or its state can't be read) and, unless `auth` is `none`, `401` (no credentials, or ones that don't verify) and `403` (the caller's role is below the route's; or a session's request that changes something without its `X-CSRF-Token`). A `202` means accepted, not done: a pipeline command or a snapshot job is carried out by the node that holds the pipeline's lease, a reload is published, a leave or a shutdown is under way on the node called.

**Who did it.** Every route that changes something takes an optional JSON body `{"note": "…"}` and records the action in the cluster's events: what, to what, the caller's name and role as the node verified them, the note, and how it ended (`accepted`, `unchanged`, `refused`). A caller turned away for its role, or with no role mapped, is recorded too (`action.denied`). A note longer than 500 characters, not a string or holding a control character, or a body that isn't a JSON object, is `422`; a body over 1 MiB is `413`; either way nothing is done or recorded.

**Hashes.** A hash the API shows of a config text (a generation's `hash`, a node's `file_hash`, `file.hash` and `file.generation_hash`) is the text's fingerprint keyed with the cluster's fingerprint key, never its plain hash, the gossiped ones its first 16 hex: comparable across the nodes of one cluster only, and no help to someone guessing a secret of a masked text.

**Outside `/v1`**, with no credentials: `GET /health/live` (the process answers), `GET /health/ready` (`200` once the node runs its config, `503` before and while it stops) and `GET /metrics` (Prometheus text).

## pipelines

Pipelines: their state, and the lifecycle commands.

### `GET /v1/pipelines`

Every pipeline: its desired and actual states and its holder

Least role: `viewer`.


| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the pipelines |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

### `GET /v1/pipelines/{id}`

A pipeline: its states, its holder, its position and its halted tables

Least role: `viewer`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the pipeline |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

### `POST /v1/pipelines/{id}/flush`

Flush now

Least role: `operator`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.
- Body: `application/json`.
- `note`: why, kept with the action's event (optional, at most 500 characters).

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | paused: flushed already |
| `202` | asked: the owner acts at its next poll |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |
| `409` | stopped, or no node holds the lease |
| `413` | the body is over 1 MiB |
| `422` | the note is too long, not a string, holds a control character, or the body isn't a JSON object |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

### `GET /v1/pipelines/{id}/live`

What the pipeline's worker shows now, from the node that runs it: its phase, lag, source detail, and each table's state, figures and freshness; another node asks the lease holder

Least role: `viewer`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the worker's figures |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |
| `409` | no node holds the lease |
| `421` | a forwarded request to a node that doesn't run the worker |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |
| `502` | the holder didn't answer |
| `503` | the node is starting or stopping, or its state can't be read; or the holder can't be asked: not a member, or no API address |
| `504` | the holder didn't answer in time |

### `POST /v1/pipelines/{id}/pause`

Pause: flush to a transaction boundary, then read nothing; the connection and the lease stay

Least role: `operator`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.
- Body: `application/json`.
- `note`: why, kept with the action's event (optional, at most 500 characters).

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | paused already |
| `202` | the desired state is paused |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |
| `409` | the pipeline is stopped |
| `413` | the body is over 1 MiB |
| `422` | the note is too long, not a string, holds a control character, or the body isn't a JSON object |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

### `POST /v1/pipelines/{id}/restart`

Restart: discard what is unflushed and replay from the checkpoint, under the same lease; a pipeline in ERROR runs again

Least role: `operator`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.
- Body: `application/json`.
- `note`: why, kept with the action's event (optional, at most 500 characters).

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `202` | asked: the owner acts at its next poll |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |
| `409` | paused, stopped, or no node holds the lease |
| `413` | the body is over 1 MiB |
| `422` | the note is too long, not a string, holds a control character, or the body isn't a JSON object |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

### `POST /v1/pipelines/{id}/resume`

Resume a paused or stopped pipeline

Least role: `operator`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.
- Body: `application/json`.
- `note`: why, kept with the action's event (optional, at most 500 characters).

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | running already |
| `202` | the desired state is running |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |
| `413` | the body is over 1 MiB |
| `422` | the note is too long, not a string, holds a control character, or the body isn't a JSON object |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

### `GET /v1/pipelines/{id}/snapshots`

The pipeline's snapshot jobs, oldest first

Least role: `viewer`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the jobs |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

### `POST /v1/pipelines/{id}/snapshots`

Snapshot tables on demand, `{"tables": [...]}`, each named exactly; one outside the config is copied, not streamed

Least role: `operator`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.
- Body: `application/json`.
- `note`: why, kept with the action's event (optional, at most 500 characters).

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `202` | the job is queued: the owner restarts the worker, which takes its tables |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |
| `409` | paused, stopped, no node holds the lease, or an unfinished job holds a table |
| `413` | the body is over 1 MiB |
| `422` | the body names no table, a glob, or a table not in the source's form; or the note is too long, not a string, holds a control character, or the body isn't a JSON object |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

### `POST /v1/pipelines/{id}/stop`

Stop: flush, and close the source connection; the lease stays

Least role: `operator`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.
- Body: `application/json`.
- `note`: why, kept with the action's event (optional, at most 500 characters).

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | stopped already |
| `202` | the desired state is stopped |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |
| `413` | the body is over 1 MiB |
| `422` | the note is too long, not a string, holds a control character, or the body isn't a JSON object |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

### `GET /v1/pipelines/{id}/tables/{table}`

A table of the pipeline, named as its config names it: what the worker shows of it, its halt and when it began, the Delta table's facts (read on request, kept 30 s), its columns at the source against Delta's, and the snapshot jobs that copied it

Least role: `viewer`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.
- Path parameter `table`: the table, named as its config key: `schema.table` on PostgreSQL, the table alone on MySQL.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the table |
| `400` | a table name not in the source's form |
| `404` | no such pipeline, or no trace of the table in it |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

## tables

Every pipeline's tables, each as its lease holder's worker shows it now.

### `GET /v1/tables`

Every pipeline's tables, worst first, as each lease holder's worker shows them: by listed state (halted, stale, snapshot, costly, streaming, copied), pipeline, and text in the name; a pipeline whose holder can't be asked lists its halted tables from storage and is named under `unreachable`

Least role: `viewer`.


| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the tables, with counts by listed state |
| `400` | a parameter that isn't one, or a state that isn't |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

## snapshots

Snapshot jobs started through the API.

### `GET /v1/snapshots`

Every pipeline's snapshot jobs, newest request first: by status, pipeline and who asked; a pipeline whose jobs can't be read is named under `unreadable`

Least role: `viewer`.

- Query parameter `status`: queued, running, cancelling, completed, failed or cancelled; several comma-separated.
- Query parameter `pipeline`: a pipeline's id.
- Query parameter `by`: who asked for it.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the jobs |
| `400` | a parameter that isn't one, or a status that isn't |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

### `GET /v1/snapshots/{job_id}`

A snapshot job: its status and each table's

Least role: `viewer`.

- Path parameter `job_id`: the snapshot job's id, `<pipeline id>~<suffix>`.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the job |
| `404` | no such job |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

### `POST /v1/snapshots/{job_id}/cancel`

Cancel a job: the pipeline's next start ends its unended tables; a table it was bringing back from a halt, or a truncating job had begun to copy, halts, COPY_CANCELLED

Least role: `operator`.

- Path parameter `job_id`: the snapshot job's id, `<pipeline id>~<suffix>`.
- Body: `application/json`.
- `note`: why, kept with the action's event (optional, at most 500 characters).

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | cancelled already |
| `202` | cancelling: the owner restarts the worker, or the pipeline's next start ends it |
| `404` | no such job |
| `409` | the job has ended |
| `413` | the body is over 1 MiB |
| `422` | the body isn't `{"note": ...}`; or the note is too long, not a string, holds a control character, or the body isn't a JSON object |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

### `POST /v1/snapshots/{job_id}/retry`

Retry an ended job: a new job of its tables, `{"tables": "all" | "not_copied", "truncate": ...}`, that records the job it retries

Least role: `operator`.

- Path parameter `job_id`: the snapshot job's id, `<pipeline id>~<suffix>`.
- Body: `application/json`.
- `note`: why, kept with the action's event (optional, at most 500 characters).

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `202` | the new job is queued |
| `404` | no such job |
| `409` | the job hasn't ended, it left no table to copy, the pipeline doesn't run, no node holds its lease, or an unfinished job holds a table |
| `413` | the body is over 1 MiB |
| `422` | the body isn't of that form; or the note is too long, not a string, holds a control character, or the body isn't a JSON object |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

## config

The config generation the cluster runs: validate, publish, status.

### `GET /v1/config/diff`

What differs between two config generations as written: each change's path, what a reload of it does, before and after, secrets and a URL's credentials masked

Least role: `viewer`.

- Query parameter `from`: the generation compared from.
- Query parameter `to`: the generation compared to.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the pipelines added and removed, and the changes |
| `400` | from or to missing, or not a number |
| `404` | no such generation |
| `409` | several snapshots of one and no record of which it is |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |
| `500` | a text couldn't be compared |
| `503` | the node is starting or stopping, or its state can't be read; or the config generations can't be read |

### `GET /v1/config/generations`

The config generations, newest first: who published each, why, and what it changed

Least role: `viewer`.

- Query parameter `before`: generations older than this one: the `next` of the page before.
- Query parameter `limit`: at most this many (1–100, 20 by default).

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the generations, each `hash` its text's keyed fingerprint (comparable across nodes of one cluster only), and `next` when the page is full |
| `400` | a parameter that isn't one, or isn't in its form |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |
| `503` | the node is starting or stopping, or its state can't be read; or the config generations can't be read |

### `GET /v1/config/generations/{generation}`

One config generation and its text, its secrets masked and its comments shown empty

Least role: `viewer`.

- Path parameter `generation`: a config generation's number.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the generation and its text, a URL's credentials masked (`••••••@`) and every comment shown empty (`#`); `hash` is the text's keyed fingerprint, comparable across nodes of one cluster only |
| `400` | a generation that isn't a number |
| `404` | no such generation |
| `409` | several snapshots of it and no record of which one it is |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |
| `500` | its text couldn't be masked, so it isn't shown: it has a merge key (`<<`), a tag (a `!` after a space), a directive or a byte-order mark, or a secret or a comment the masker can't place |
| `503` | the node is starting or stopping, or its state can't be read; or the config generations can't be read |

### `GET /v1/config/nodes`

Each member's config generation, whether its own file is the cluster's generation, and its fields waiting for a restart

Least role: `viewer`.


| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the generation the cluster runs, its `hash` (its text's keyed fingerprint, comparable across nodes of one cluster only), and each member: `file` compares the keyed fingerprints of the member's file and of that text |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

### `POST /v1/config/reload`

Publish the node's file as the next config generation; `?restart=accept` publishes a restart-only field, applied at each node's next start

Least role: `operator`.

- Body: `application/json`.
- `note`: why, kept with the action's event (optional, at most 500 characters).

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the file is the generation the cluster runs |
| `202` | published: the generation, and this node's fields pending a restart |
| `400` | a query other than restart=accept |
| `409` | other nodes published first, every time |
| `413` | the body is over 1 MiB |
| `422` | invalid, or it changes a restart-only field without restart=accept, or a field the cluster keeps for good: the report; or the note is too long, not a string, holds a control character, or the body isn't a JSON object |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

### `GET /v1/config/status`

The generation the cluster runs, and each member's

Least role: `viewer`.


| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the generations |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

### `POST /v1/config/validate`

Check a config, the body or else the node's file: what a reload of it would change. Nothing is published

Least role: `operator`.

- Body: `application/yaml`.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | it loads: its warnings and the changes |
| `422` | invalid, or it changes a restart-only field: the report |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long; or posted bodies past the node's rate: `Retry-After` says when |

## cluster

Membership and leases.

### `POST /v1/cluster/leave`

Leave the cluster: hand every pipeline off; the process stays up, not ready

Least role: `admin`.

- Body: `application/json`.
- `note`: why, kept with the action's event (optional, at most 500 characters).

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `202` | the leave is under way |
| `409` | leaving already |
| `413` | the body is over 1 MiB |
| `422` | the note is too long, not a string, holds a control character, or the body isn't a JSON object |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

### `GET /v1/cluster/status`

The members this node sees, and each pipeline's lease holder

Least role: `viewer`.


| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the members and the holders; a member's `file_hash` is its file's keyed fingerprint (first 16 hex), comparable across nodes of one cluster only |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

## admin

The node's process.

### `POST /v1/admin/shutdown`

Shut down: leave the cluster, then end the process

Least role: `admin`.

- Body: `application/json`.
- `note`: why, kept with the action's event (optional, at most 500 characters).

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `202` | the shutdown is under way |
| `409` | shutting down already |
| `413` | the body is over 1 MiB |
| `422` | the note is too long, not a string, holds a control character, or the body isn't a JSON object |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

## nodes

Any member, through any node: its detail, and the actions only it takes, sent to it with the caller's own credentials. A node that doesn't answer is named (`502`, `504`).

### `GET /v1/nodes/{node}`

A node's detail: its build and start, its file against its generation, its process and gossip figures, the leases it holds; another node's is fetched from it

Least role: `viewer`.

- Path parameter `node`: a member's name, as the gossip knows it.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the node's detail; `file.hash` and `file.generation_hash` are keyed fingerprints (first 16 hex), comparable across nodes of one cluster only |
| `404` | no member of that name in this node's view |
| `421` | a request forwarded to a node that isn't its target |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |
| `502` | the node didn't answer |
| `503` | the node is starting or stopping, or its state can't be read; or the member gossips no API address |
| `504` | the node didn't answer within the time limit |

### `POST /v1/nodes/{node}/config/reload`

Publish a node's own file as the next generation, through any node: its own `POST /v1/config/reload`, with the query

Least role: `operator`.

- Path parameter `node`: a member's name, as the gossip knows it.
- Body: `application/json`.
- `note`: why, kept with the action's event (optional, at most 500 characters).

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the file is the generation the cluster runs |
| `202` | published |
| `404` | no member of that name in this node's view |
| `409` | other nodes published first, every time |
| `413` | the body is over 1 MiB |
| `421` | a request forwarded to a node that isn't its target |
| `422` | invalid, or a restart-only field without restart=accept; or the note is too long, not a string, holds a control character, or the body isn't a JSON object |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |
| `502` | the node didn't answer |
| `503` | the node is starting or stopping, or its state can't be read; or the member gossips no API address |
| `504` | the node didn't answer within the time limit |

### `GET /v1/nodes/{node}/config/status`

A node's generation and its own restart-pending fields: its own `GET /v1/config/status`

Least role: `viewer`.

- Path parameter `node`: a member's name, as the gossip knows it.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the node's config status |
| `404` | no member of that name in this node's view |
| `421` | a request forwarded to a node that isn't its target |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

| `503` | the node is starting or stopping, or its state can't be read; or the member gossips no API address |

### `POST /v1/nodes/{node}/config/validate`

Check a node's own file (an empty body), or the body, on that node: its own `POST /v1/config/validate`

- Path parameter `node`: a member's name, as the gossip knows it.

| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long; or posted bodies past the node's rate |

## events

The cluster's timeline and audit trail, kept for `globals.console.events.retention`.

### `GET /v1/events`

The cluster's events and audit trail, newest first: actions with who took them, lease hand-offs, halts, schema changes, snapshot jobs, members, config generations

Least role: `viewer`.

- Query parameter `since`: events at or after this time (RFC 3339).
- Query parameter `until`: events before this time (RFC 3339).
- Query parameter `kind`: a kind or a family (`action`, `lease.takeover`); repeat it for several.
- Query parameter `object`: a pipeline's id, or an object's name (a table, a job, a node).
- Query parameter `actor`: the name of who caused it.
- Query parameter `node`: the node that recorded it.
- Query parameter `q`: text in the event or its note, without case.
- Query parameter `limit`: at most this many (1–1000, 100 by default).
- Query parameter `after`: the `next` of the page before: go on from there.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the events, and `next` when there are more |
| `400` | a parameter that isn't one, or isn't in its form |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |

## history

The series the nodes sampled for charts, kept for `globals.console.history.retention`; a pipeline's older range from `globals.console.prometheus` when it is set.

### `GET /v1/history`

The series the nodes sampled, over a range: a pipeline's, a table's or a node's, from any node

Least role: `viewer`.

- Query parameter `pipeline`: a pipeline's id, or several comma-separated; without it or `node`, every pipeline.
- Query parameter `table`: a table of the one pipeline asked, as its config key: the table's series.
- Query parameter `node`: a node's name: the node's series.
- Query parameter `series`: the series, comma-separated; by default every series of what is asked.
- Query parameter `since`: from this time (RFC 3339); an hour before `until` by default.
- Query parameter `until`: to this time (RFC 3339); now by default.
- Query parameter `step`: seconds between points; by default, and at the finest, the samples' own, coarsened to at most 1440 points.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | each series' points, `[unix seconds, value]`, oldest first; `kept_since`: where the history kept starts |
| `400` | a parameter that isn't one, or isn't in its form |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |
| `503` | the node is starting or stopping, or its state can't be read; or the chart history can't be read |

## stream

The cluster's live changes as server-sent events, from any node, without replay: read the current state, then apply what follows.

### `GET /v1/stream`

The cluster's live changes as server-sent events, from any node: each pipeline's state and figures, each node's own, the samples taken and the events written, as they happen

Least role: `viewer`.

- Query parameter `pipeline`: a pipeline's id, or several comma-separated: only the messages about them; by default every message.
- Query parameter `kind`: the kinds sent, comma-separated, of `pipeline`, `figures`, `node`, `samples`, `event`; by default every kind.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | `text/event-stream`: `hello` first, then each change as it happens, without replay: read the current state, then apply what follows |
| `400` | a parameter that isn't one, or isn't in its form |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |
| `503` | the node is starting or stopping, or its state can't be read; or as many streams are open on this node as it takes; `Retry-After` says when to try again |

## openapi.json

The document this page is rendered from.

### `GET /v1/openapi.json`

This document

Least role: `viewer`.


| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the OpenAPI document |
| `429` | with `basic`: the caller's address failed too many basic sign-ins, and waits: `Retry-After` says how long |
